gripOrHq.title: Team Restructuring
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add one advancement counter to each of up to two installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Systematic Layoffs
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Bizarre Encryption Scheme
gripOrHq.rulesText: Bizarre Encryption Scheme may only be installed in a subsidiary data fort. Runner does not score any agenda (or agendas) that he or she accesses from this fort; return the agenda to the fort instead. Runner scores the agenda at the start of his or her next turn if it is still in the fort.

gripOrHq.title: Cowboy Sysop
gripOrHq.rulesText: A: Choose one of your installed cards to be uninstalled. Store it in HQ.

heapOrArchives.title: Systematic Layoffs
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Add two advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

discardCards.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
discardCards.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

discardCards.title: Panzer Run
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: Sneak Preview
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

discardCards.title: Chiba Bank Account
discardCards.rulesText: [1], [T]: Gain [4]. You may use this ability whenever you pay any cost or penalty. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

discardCards.title: Rent-I-Con
discardCards.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

discardCards.title: Social Engineering
discardCards.rulesText: Hide at least 2 from your pool in your hand; the Corp then guesses how many bits you hid. If the Corp guesses correctly, lose that many bits. Otherwise, choose a data fort and a piece of ice on that fort. Then make a run on that fort, during which you automatically pass that piece of ice.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

ice.title: Ice Pick Willie
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Canis Major
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +2 strength.

ice.title: Virizz
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay an additional [1] to break each ice subroutine.

root.title: Systematic Layoffs

ice.title: Neural Blade
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

ice.title: Canis Major
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +2 strength.
